bss.topic: Revisão do 1º trimestre: mapas, regiões e início da colonização

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Quais são os quatro pontos cardeais?
questions.hint: São usados na rosa dos ventos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Para que serve a legenda de um mapa?
options: Explicar o significado dos símbolos e cores
questions.answer: Explicar o significado dos símbolos e cores
questions.hint: Ela 'traduz' o mapa.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Quantas regiões oficiais tem o Brasil?
questions.hint: Lembre de Norte, Nordeste…

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em qual região do Brasil fica o estado de São Paulo?
questions.hint: É a mesma região do Rio de Janeiro e de Minas Gerais.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual é a maior região do Brasil em área?
questions.hint: É onde fica grande parte da Floresta Amazônica.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O sol nasce em qual ponto cardeal?
questions.hint: É também chamado de nascente ou oriente.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que ano a frota de Pedro Álvares Cabral chegou ao território que hoje é o Brasil?
questions.hint: Foi no início do século XVI.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Quem já vivia nas terras do Brasil quando os portugueses chegaram?
questions.hint: Eram muitos povos, com línguas e costumes diferentes.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual árvore deu nome ao Brasil e foi a primeira riqueza explorada pelos portugueses?
questions.hint: Sua madeira produzia tinta vermelha.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que foram as capitanias hereditárias?
options: Faixas de terra entregues pelo rei de Portugal a donatários
questions.answer: Faixas de terra entregues pelo rei de Portugal a donatários
questions.hint: Hereditária quer dizer que passava de pai para filho.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual produto passou a ser muito cultivado no litoral do Nordeste no início da colonização?
questions.hint: Dela se fazia um produto doce muito valioso na Europa.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes eventos aconteceu primeiro?
questions.hint: Organize em uma linha do tempo.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Coloque na ordem certa: (A) capitanias hereditárias, (B) chegada dos portugueses, (C) exploração do pau-brasil.
questions.hint: Primeiro chegaram, depois exploraram, depois organizaram as terras.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em uma linha do tempo, os acontecimentos são organizados:
questions.hint: Cronos = tempo.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique, com suas palavras, uma mudança que a chegada dos portugueses trouxe para os povos indígenas.
questions.hint: Pense em terras, costumes ou doenças.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Descreva como você usaria um mapa e os pontos cardeais para explicar a um colega onde fica a sua casa em relação à escola.
questions.hint: Use palavras como norte, sul, leste, oeste e legenda.

en.topic: Term 1 review: relative clauses, parenthesis and cohesion

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence contains a relative clause?
options: The dog that lives next door barks loudly.
The dog barks loudly every night.
questions.answer: The dog that lives next door barks loudly.
questions.hint: Look for 'who', 'which', 'that', 'where' or 'whose'.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the correct relative pronoun: 'The girl ___ bike was stolen called the police.'
questions.hint: It shows possession.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Fill in the relative pronoun: 'This is the park ___ we played football.'
questions.hint: It refers to a place.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which relative pronoun is best for things, not people?
questions.hint: 'Who' is for people.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence uses brackets for parenthesis correctly?
options: My aunt (who lives in Wales) is visiting.
My (aunt who) lives in Wales is visiting.
My aunt who (lives) in Wales is visiting.
(My aunt who lives in Wales is visiting.)
questions.answer: My aunt (who lives in Wales) is visiting.
questions.hint: The sentence should still make sense without the brackets.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which punctuation can NOT be used for parenthesis?
questions.hint: Parenthesis needs a pair of marks.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is the name for extra information added to a sentence using brackets, dashes or commas?
questions.hint: It starts with 'p'.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word is a modal verb?
questions.hint: Modal verbs show how likely something is.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which modal verb shows the highest certainty?
questions.hint: Which one sounds most definite?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word is an adverb of possibility?
questions.hint: It tells how likely something is.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which is a cohesive device that links paragraphs?
questions.hint: It connects time between paragraphs.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the best cohesive word: 'It rained all morning. ___, the match was cancelled.'
questions.hint: Which shows cause and effect?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In 'Mr Patel, who teaches music, plays the violin', what is the role of 'who teaches music'?
options: It is a relative clause giving extra information
questions.answer: It is a relative clause giving extra information
questions.hint: Can you remove it and keep a full sentence?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence uses dashes for parenthesis correctly?
options: The castle – built in 1200 – stands on a hill.
The castle built – in 1200 stands on a hill.
– The castle built in 1200 stands on a hill.
The castle built in 1200 stands – on a hill.
questions.answer: The castle – built in 1200 – stands on a hill.
questions.hint: The dashes go around the extra information.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Write one sentence about a hobby that includes a relative clause and a modal verb.
questions.hint: Use 'who', 'which' or 'that' and a word like 'could' or 'might'.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Write two sentences about a trip and link them with a cohesive device. Underline or name the device you used.
questions.hint: Try words like 'however', 'afterwards' or 'as a result'.

en_read.topic: Term 1 review: retrieval, inference and genre

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What is a retrieval question?
options: A question whose answer can be found directly in the text
A question asking for your opinion
A question about the author's life
questions.answer: A question whose answer can be found directly in the text
questions.hint: 'Retrieve' means to fetch.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Read: 'Zara pulled her coat tighter and watched her breath float away like smoke.' What can you infer?
questions.hint: What makes breath look like smoke?

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Read: 'The museum opens at 9 a.m. and closes at 5 p.m. every day except Monday.' On which day is the museum closed?
questions.hint: Look for the word 'except'.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Read: 'Tom slammed the door and stomped up the stairs without a word.' How is Tom feeling?
questions.hint: Think about the verbs 'slammed' and 'stomped'.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What is the word for a reading skill where you use clues to work out something the text doesn't say directly?
questions.hint: It is linked to the verb 'infer'.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which feature is most typical of a non-chronological report?
questions.hint: Think of an information text about an animal.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which genre usually begins with 'Once upon a time'?
questions.hint: Think of traditional stories.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which genre uses imperative verbs like 'Mix', 'Cut' and 'Place'?
questions.hint: These verbs are commands.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: A newspaper report usually includes:
questions.hint: Who, what, where, when, why.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Read: 'Leo checked his watch for the fifth time and tapped his foot.' What can you infer?
options: Leo is lost in a forest
questions.hint: Why do people keep checking the time?

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: When answering an inference question, what should you include?
questions.hint: Use a quotation to prove your idea.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which is written in the first person and records personal feelings?
questions.hint: It uses 'I' and 'my'.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Read: 'The sky turned black, and the birds fell silent.' What is the author most likely preparing the reader for?
questions.hint: What could cause this change in mood?

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What do we call a story that explains natural events and often includes gods or magical creatures?
questions.hint: It is often from ancient cultures.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Compare two genres you read this term. Write one similarity and one difference.
questions.hint: Think about purpose, layout and language.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Read: 'Maya smiled, but her hands were shaking as she stepped onto the stage.' What can you infer about Maya? Use evidence.
questions.hint: Look at the contrast between her smile and her hands.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Fill in the missing letters and write the whole word: suspi_ _ous
questions.hint: This ending sounds like 'shus'.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Fill in the missing letters and write the whole word: nutri_ _ous
questions.hint: Think of the root word 'nutrition'.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which spelling is correct?
questions.hint: Think of the root word 'essence'... but the ending is -tial.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Fill in the missing letters and write the whole word: thor_ _gh
questions.hint: It has the letters 'ough' at the end.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which word has a silent 'n'?
questions.hint: Listen to the last sound.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which ending completes the word 'offi___'?
questions.hint: Think of the root word 'office'.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which ending completes the word 'par___' (meaning 'partly')?
questions.hint: Think of the root word 'part'.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which word is spelt correctly?
questions.hint: Think of 'innocence'.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which word has a silent letter?
questions.hint: Which word has a letter you can't hear at the start?

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Spot the mistakes: find and fix the 5 misspelled words.
questions.answer: commitee → committee; nutritous → nutritious; thurough → thorough; essencial → essential; confidance → confidence
questions.hint: Check double letters and the endings -tious, -tial and -ence.
questions.text: Our class commitee planned a nutritous picnic for the whole school. We checked the weather in a thurough way and packed essencial supplies like water and fruit. Everyone was full of confidance that the day would be a success, and we did achieve our goal.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Choose the correct spelling of the word that means 'a feeling of being sure of yourself'.
questions.hint: Think of the adjective 'confident'.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Choose the correct spelling of the noun formed from 'observe'.
questions.hint: Think of the adjective 'observant'.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Choose the correct spelling of the verb meaning 'to succeed in reaching a goal'.
questions.hint: Remember: i before e except after c.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Choose the correct spelling of the word for 'a group of people chosen to make decisions'.
questions.hint: It has three sets of double letters.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Choose the correct spelling of the word meaning 'certain, without doubt'.
questions.hint: Look for a smaller word meaning 'limited' inside it.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Spot the mistakes: find and fix the 4 misspelled words.
questions.answer: suspicous → suspicious; definate → definite; solem → solemn; acheive → achieve
questions.hint: Look for silent letters, i before e, and the -cious ending.
questions.text: The detective gave the stranger a suspicous look. It was definate that something was wrong. In a solem voice, he asked the man why he was standing outside the old house. The man said he wanted to acheive his dream of becoming an artist and was only sketching the building.

ipc.topic: Term 1 review: space, AD 900 and the active Earth

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: How many planets are in our Solar System?
questions.hint: Pluto is now called a dwarf planet.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which is the largest planet in our Solar System?
questions.hint: It is a gas giant.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: What is at the centre of our Solar System?
questions.hint: All the planets orbit it.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Why would astronauts on Mars need special suits?
options: The air is thin and has very little oxygen
questions.answer: The air is thin and has very little oxygen
questions.hint: Think about what humans need to breathe.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Around AD 900, which civilisation built great cities like Baghdad as a centre of learning?
questions.hint: It had the House of Wisdom.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Around AD 900, which civilisation in Central America built stone pyramids and used a calendar?
questions.hint: They lived in what is now Mexico and Guatemala.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which group from Scandinavia was sailing and trading across Europe around AD 900?
questions.hint: They were famous for longships.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: What is the hot, central part of the Earth called?
questions.hint: It is made mostly of iron and nickel.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which layer of the Earth do we live on?
questions.hint: It is the thinnest, outer layer.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: What are the giant moving pieces of the Earth's crust called?
questions.hint: They move very slowly.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: What happens when tectonic plates suddenly move against each other?
questions.hint: The ground shakes.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: What is melted rock called when it comes out of a volcano?
questions.hint: Underground it is called magma.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Where do many volcanoes and earthquakes happen?
options: Near the edges of tectonic plates
In the middle of every ocean equally
questions.answer: Near the edges of tectonic plates
questions.hint: Think of the 'Ring of Fire'.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Choose one civilisation from around AD 900 and describe one thing it was good at.
questions.hint: Think about buildings, learning, trade or exploration.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Reflect on this term: which learning goal did you improve most, and how do you know?
questions.hint: Think about something you can do now that you couldn't before.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which planet in our Solar System has a reddish colour because of iron oxide (rust) in its soil?
questions.hint: It was the planet we studied in our space mission unit.

math.topic: Term 1 review: number, calculation, perimeter and area

questions.subject: math
questions.q: What is the value of the digit 7 in 374,512?
questions.hint: Count the places from the right.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Round 46,782 to the nearest thousand.
questions.hint: Look at the hundreds digit.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Round 238,450 to the nearest 10,000.
questions.hint: Look at the thousands digit.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: The temperature is -4 °C. It rises by 9 degrees. What is the new temperature in °C?
questions.hint: Count up from -4 on a number line.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Which number is the smallest?
questions.hint: On a number line, it is furthest to the left.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Calculate 4,567 + 3,858.
questions.hint: Use column addition and remember to carry.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Calculate 7,003 − 2,468.
questions.hint: Use column subtraction and exchange carefully.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Calculate 2,345 × 6.
questions.hint: Multiply each digit by 6, starting with the ones.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Calculate 1,236 ÷ 4.
questions.hint: Use short division.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Which of these is a factor of 36?
questions.hint: Which divides 36 with no remainder?

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Which number is a prime number?
questions.hint: A prime has exactly two factors.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A rectangle is 12 cm long and 5 cm wide. What is its perimeter in cm?
questions.hint: Add all four sides.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A rectangle is 9 m long and 7 m wide. What is its area in m²?
questions.hint: Area = length × width.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A square has a perimeter of 36 cm. What is its area in cm²?
questions.hint: First find the length of one side.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A garden is 15 m by 8 m. A path of area 20 m² is paved. How many m² of the garden are NOT paved?
questions.hint: Find the total area first.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Explain how you would check the answer to 1,236 ÷ 4 using the inverse operation.
questions.hint: Which operation undoes division?
